name: Preferred Source Procurements FY15
description: This dataset lists procurements from fiscal year 2015 that were awarded through preferred source purchasing, with each record showing the reason or commodity/service category for the procurement and the associated contract value. With 21 rows and two columns, it provides a compact summary of how much was spent across different preferred source categories. It could be used to analyze spending patterns by procurement reason, compare contract values across commodity and service types, or support budget and procurement reporting.
